text: The Stampacchia Gold Medal is an international award given every three years by the Italian Mathematical Union (Unione Matematica Italiana – UMI {it}) in collaboration with the Ettore Majorana Foundation (Erice), honoring exceptional achievements in the field of Calculus of Variations and its related applications.[1] The medal is named after the Italian mathematician Guido Stampacchia and is awarded to a mathematician who is not older than 35 years of age.
